newsitem.title: GREECE: OTE'S NEW PHONE CARD CELEBRATES GREEK REVOLUTION.
newsitem.headline: OTE'S NEW PHONE CARD CELEBRATES GREEK REVOLUTION.

text.p: OTE telecom is issuing a new phone card to mark a National Gallery exhibition of French painters on the Greek revolution. The exhibition ends April 25, it said.
The phone card features details from Eugene Delacroix's painting "Greece in the ruins of Messolongi".
Buyers of the new phonecard will have a 50 percent discount for tickets to see the exhibit at the National Gallery. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
